run_unit_tests: run the fastText unit tests by calling runtests.py with the --unit-tests flag
run_integration_tests: run the fastText integration tests by calling runtests.py with --integration-tests and --data-dir
run_tests_with_verbosity: run fastText tests with a custom verbosity level using the --verbose flag
call_run_tests_programmatically: call the run_tests function with a unittest TestLoader suite to execute tests
generate_unit_tests: generate fastText unit test cases using gen_unit_tests with an optional verbose parameter
